---
title: "Examples"
description: "Real project analyses and provenance."
---

Examples are real project workflows retained for provenance, practical context,
and worked examples. They may contain project-specific paths, labels,
assumptions, and external inputs; they are not guaranteed to run from a clean
clone and are not canonical templates.

The generalized reusable versions are under [Methods](methods.qmd).

## Project groups

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .resource-card}
### MAP single-cell and multiome workflows

The coupled [MAP project overview](examples/single_cell/map/README.md) covers
the RNA/ATAC, transfer, trajectory, velocity, network, and metabolic workflows
that informed several canonical templates.

[Browse the MAP source directory on GitHub](https://github.com/Thokas99/Useful_code/tree/main/examples/single_cell/map)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .resource-card}
### TRENTO biomarker ML

The [TRENTO overview](examples/biomarker_ml/trento/README.md) preserves the
project model and reporting notebooks behind the biomarker classification
templates.

[Browse the TRENTO source directory on GitHub](https://github.com/Thokas99/Useful_code/tree/main/examples/biomarker_ml/trento)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .resource-card}
### MGI organoids bulk RNA

The [organoid bulk-RNA overview](examples/bulk_rna/mgi_organoids/README.md)
retains the source QC, GSEA, and Hallmark scoring workflows.

[Browse the organoid source directory on GitHub](https://github.com/Thokas99/Useful_code/tree/main/examples/bulk_rna/mgi_organoids)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .resource-card}
### TCGA and CPTAC multi-omics

The [TCGA/MOFA overview](examples/multiomics/tcga_mofa/README.md) and
[CPTAC-LUAD overview](examples/multiomics/cptac_luad/README.md) preserve the
project-specific multi-omics workflows and scoring context.

[Browse the multi-omics examples on GitHub](https://github.com/Thokas99/Useful_code/tree/main/examples/multiomics)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .resource-card}
### GSE171145

The [GSE171145 source notebook](https://github.com/Thokas99/Useful_code/blob/main/examples/single_cell/gse171145.qmd)
is retained as a concrete single-cell cohort workflow. It is linked to GitHub
rather than required as a site-rendered analysis page.
:::

:::

The repository's [examples index](examples/README.md) provides the corresponding
source-oriented inventory.
